name: Leonardo DiCaprio
role: American actor and film producer; environmental activist and UN Messenger of Peace (climate change, from 2014)
summary: DiCaprio is an actor whose public political advocacy is almost entirely about climate and the environment, through speeches, documentaries and his foundation. He has called for large-scale government and industry action, a price on carbon and an end to fossil fuel subsidies. He has stated no recorded positions on most other political questions.
